title: Went quiet for a week to fix how my guns sit on screen, so I built a live weapon tuner into my browser FPS
author: Ditex_Design
selftext: Haven't posted in about a week, because I disappeared into one problem: with 20 guns in BLOCKRIFT (my solo browser arena FPS), half of them were floating, clipping, or way the wrong size in first person. My machine gun looked like an SMG. Every fix meant edit → reload → rejoin → look. So I built a dev-only tuner that runs while I'm actually playing: - Hip pose: x / y / z + pitch, yaw, roll - ADS: distance, offset, zoom - Sight and muzzle points, so the red dot lines up and the flash comes from the barrel - Third-person preview to check the gun on the character - Colour markers on the muzzle, sight and hand points - Freeze bots, so I can tune mid-match without getting shot - "Copy tuning to same category", so one good rifle setup carries over to the other rifles Shift = 10× step, F9 closes it and I'm straight back in the match. Each gun went from an afternoon of guessing to a few minutes.
